objective: Analyze documented technical security controls and evidence gaps.

review-technical-controls.expected_when: An explicit project_root is supplied and the routine is due.
review-technical-controls.acceptance: Produces working/technical-controls-assessment.md from provided evidence and states blockers and limitations.
review-technical-controls.fallback: Write a blocker artifact; never infer missing evidence.
review-technical-controls.recovery: Re-read current project inputs and continue within this eligible run.
